description: Land Title Settlement Department - Calling for claims to Intestate property of Udugama, Meerigama D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510243 and 8 other properties
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land and property matters, specifically notices calling for claims to intestate property under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed land information including cadastral map numbers, parcel numbers, land extents, and certificate of title numbers. The content focuses on property registration and title settlement processes for deceased individuals' estates, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership, and land title matters.
